intro.title: Agate Eye
intro.description: Collection of stunning Agate Eye which is a natural Agate Gemstone with concentric color banding that gives it the formation of an eye. Also called Third Eye Agate and Shiva Eye Agate, they are symbolic of the inner eye/intuitive eye. The Agate Eye is available in a set of two. Keep them where cash is kept, in your altar or carry them on yourself. It is excellent in building your intuitive power, creative skills and enhancing focus. It protects from psychic attacks, evil eye, hexes and stops decrease in wealth.
